description: IDOR Eats - Food ordering platform with user authentication and restaurant search functionality. Primary web application running on Apache 2.4.41 with PHP backend. The application implements a user profile system with favorite restaurants and password management features.

endpoints: /api/get_favorite_restaurants.php - Get favorite restaurants (GET, requires authentication, IDOR vulnerability with userId parameter)

notes: Critical findings: The application contains multiple IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) vulnerabilities. The api/get_favorite_restaurants.php endpoint accepts a userId parameter that can be manipulated to access other users' favorite restaurants. The api/change_password.php endpoint also accepts a userId parameter allowing privilege escalation attacks. Directory listing is enabled on /api/ and /static/images/ exposing all application files and assets. The session-based authentication is PHPSESSID cookie based, stored in PHP sessions.
